messages:
olivia: Heads-up — planning a scoped terraform apply tied to release/2026-03. Target change window 2026-03-26 23:00 UTC in us-west-2. This touches: route tables + nat-gw replacement + iam role trust changes. Please ack if any blockers.
ashwin: ack, will review tf plan and provider pin. I might flag the iam trust change for extra review.
tara: +1. Is there a canary plan? we should limit to a single AZ before full rollout.
olivia: yes canary = serial apply to az-a only (5% traffic). If canary passes, stagger rest over 1h windows. Will pin aws provider to 4.60.0 in root module.
ashwin: noted. I ran a local `terraform plan` and saw the nat-gw swap will replace 2 resources.
ashwin: ```
  # aws_nat_gateway.old will be replaced
  -/+ resource "aws_nat_gateway" "old" {
      ~ id = "gw-0abcd..." -> (known after apply)
    }
```
deploy-bot: :robot_face: queued terraform plan job `tf-plan-172` for branch release/2026-03. Plan URL: https://ci.internal/reports/tf-plan-172
sre-oncall: preflight checklist: backups ok, bump route53 TTLs to 60s, notify CS. I'm oncall; will monitor.
olivia: added CS ping and release notes draft. Also adding rollout policy: automatic abort if >5% error or >200ms median P99 latency increase for 10 min.
ashwin: We should include a rollback pin: keep previous AMI + provider 4.58.2 available for instant pin. I'll prepare a rollback plan snippet.
ashwin: ```
rollback:
  - revert module "vpc" to tag v1.12.3
  - terraform apply -target=module.vpc -var 'ami_prev=ami-0prev'
  - verify connectivity and promote canary
```
tara: production change window confirmed. I'll coordinate the schedule with infra-release channel and take the first apply.
olivia: final: apply window 23:00-02:00 UTC, canary 23:00-23:10, staggered AZs every 20m, abort on threshold. @ashwin @sre-oncall @tara please react when ready :thumbsup: 
ashwin: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: started terraform apply job `tf-apply-88` in us-west-2 (canary az-a). Logs: https://ci.internal/logs/tf-apply-88
sre-oncall: monitoring logs and metrics now.
olivia: canary completed with no errors, small latency bump 12ms. proceeding with az-b apply.
deploy-bot: az-b apply finished. az-c apply queued.
tara: az-c apply fails: iam role update blocked by external dependency. rolling back az-c and pausing rollout.
tara: deploy-bot, stop further applies and revert az-c changes.
deploy-bot: :warning: halted queue. Rolling back changes in az-c as requested. Starting rollback job `tf-rollback-9`.
ashwin: investigating iam blocker — looks like external service has a missing trust relationship. contacting identity team.
olivia: good catch. we'll keep canary AZs healthy and postpone full rollout until identity fix. reopening issue in infra tracker.
ashwin: created issue INFRA-2395 with details and rollback notes. We'll reschedule once identity is sorted.
olivia: thanks everyone. filing short post-release note summarizing canary results + abort reason.
